prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider (default 0.85). Toggle link visibility and layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button that cross-fades data using keyed .join(enter, update, exit) — never remove all nodes before rebuilding. Smooth position interpolation between layouts.
